provenance.kind: Sanitized historical aggregates plus two separately frozen public-API runtime replays and an independent fixed-output public audit; every outcome retained.
provenance.artifact_keys: Descriptive identifiers only; private file locations and raw payloads deliberately omitted.
provenance.code_hash_scope: Global code hashes are recorded by the prior private-port verifier; OOS driver/mapper/helper hashes are recorded in the pre-prediction registration. All selected hashes match current bytes. They do not identify a public-API replay. Small-domain draft hashes come from their version-specific freeze/registration manifests and also match current bytes.
provenance.combined_audit_driver_caveat: Collected current driver hash; the combined topology report does not itself pin its as-run driver hash.

bounded_environment.scope: Recorded prior private global-port verification, not inferred for every historical run. OOS reports do not record a complete environment.

scope.data: COIL20 fixed TRAIN-only PCA64 reference; 960 TRAIN and 480 held-out views. Earlier independent TRAIN48 COIL20/Fashion-MNIST diagnostics are reported separately.
scope.normalization: Positive all-pair TRAIN-distance median; same fixed TRAIN scale used for held-out features. No TEST-derived normalization or topology retuning.
scope.h0: Maximum absolute difference of source/target minimax merge distances over every same-row pair in the complete supplied domain; not sorted barcodes, original-MST edge stress, or induced witness-subset PH.
scope.h1: Same selected birth-present chains, closed over F2, independently nonboundary at survival modulo all triangle boundaries on the complete supplied domain. Rank means selected-family quotient rank, not ambient Betti number.
scope.planar: Separate target-only real-coordinate nonfilling certificate: strict protected-disk clearance of every row beyond survival/sqrt(3), birth-edge bounds and full-rank F2 winding. This does not establish source rank or replace independent matrix reduction.
no_claims: a simplicial map or isomorphism between entire source and target complexes
quality superiority over unconstrained graph embeddings
scope.held_out_split: 20 objects, 48 TRAIN and 24 held-out views each; every third 5-degree view held out. Object/angle annotations define the split, not a layout-training target.

selection.domain: all 960 TRAIN rows, no label/object cohort selection
selection.rule: One longest finite positive global Ripser H1 bar; ties by birth then solver order; fixed 20%-80% interior interval; first lexicographic MST fundamental cycle pairing one with its cocycle. No easier-bar fallback.
selection.proposal_precision: Ripser float32 endpoints; exact F2 checks at the represented float64 interval are the certification gate.

historical_full960_train.construction: Explicit hierarchy contraction max(0,U-.049) within the unchanged .05 tolerance; guide-aligned single-cycle circle, analytic contacts and protected-disk exclusion. All rows participate. Floating proposals are independently checked; not a complete feasibility solver.
historical_full960_train.h0_edge_surrogate_warning: The original-tree-edge bound fails (~13.8), while the decisive all-pair minimax criterion passes. Neither exact zero-error H0 nor preservation of original edge lengths is claimed.

saved_target_planar.scope: Prior private-port check of this saved target; not run again for this aggregate.

prior_private_port_reconstruction.matrix_precision_caveat: Stored float64 matrix H1 and real-coordinate planar geometry are separate contracts. Hypot/cdist threshold graphs agreed for this historical dataset only.

neighborhood_tradeoff.definition: Mean intersection of source/target kNN sets divided by k, all TRAIN queries, self excluded, Euclidean distances and stable row-order ties.
neighborhood_tradeoff.interpretation: Better than PCA on this metric, worse than the graph guide. PCA number was recomputed by the prior private verifier, not present in the original construction report.

earlier_small_domain_diagnostics.scope: Selected TRAIN-only domains in shared full-TRAIN-fitted PCA64 caches; not held-out generalization. Joint success requires full-domain H0 <= .05 and selected source/target rank one. All failures are retained; no raw cohort membership is published.

original48_exploratory_proofs.protocol: Eight initial exploratory arms followed by a separately declared Fashion scaffold extension; not a preregistered nine-arm comparison.
original48_exploratory_proofs.negative_finding: All seven unresolved arms have missing required birth edges/rank zero under the selected-chain check. They are not proofs of no other H1 or infeasibility.

frozen_transfer_v1.original_guides: Initial PCA and prior H1-only-certified guides both succeeded; not four independent datasets.
frozen_transfer_v1.new_cohorts: Nested 32/48/64 TRAIN cohorts for each dataset, disjoint from original cohorts; COIL64 crosses an object boundary. Initial PCA guide only, one frozen call per cohort.
frozen_transfer_v1.negative_finding: All six valid source singleton contracts remain unresolved. Two full circle candidates fail H1 birth edges; four cases produce no full candidate. Every scaffold/contact attempt stops. No omitted timeouts or source-budget/runtime exceptions were reported; unresolved embeddings are absent, not certified partial layouts.

frozen_frontier_v2.negative_finding: Five transfer cohorts remain unresolved: one already-filled fixed scaffold and four future-frontier guard conflicts. Fixed-state audits are not global infeasibility proofs. Missing birth edges remain failures even when H0 and empty-disk placement succeed.

separate_steiner_extension.new_coil32_48_64: All three full H0/hole candidates fail required H1 birth edges (rank zero).

protocol.label_timing: Predictions were frozen without labels. Evaluation driver checks the official global embedding barrier before reading labels; labels are used afterward only for the 15-NN supervised probe. No label-based fit/selection.
protocol.timing_evidence_caveat: Registration, frozen hashes and the hash-matched evaluator establish the recorded workflow; this is not an independently instrumented label-access trace.
protocol.matched_mapper: Same exact source 15-neighbor queries, fuzzy weights, fixed mapper A with all 960 frozen anchors, TRAIN-only distance bandwidth, barycentric initialization and 100-iteration query cap.
protocol.execution: One declared prediction per base arm, no retry or tuning; hole guard is deterministic postprocessing of constructive predictions, not an independent fit.
protocol.evaluation: All 480 queries against all 960 TRAIN anchors; overlap, trustworthiness and continuity at k=5,15,50. Accuracy is a separate labeled 15-NN diagnostic.
protocol.topology_units: Combined SOURCE retains TRAIN feature pipeline/scale and fixed TRAIN-selected family/interval. Graph target topology uses a TRAIN-only unit alignment; no TEST/topology-fitted rescaling.

combined_target_planar_evidence.scope: Constructive arms only, all 1440 target rows; target nonfilling does not imply source preservation or H0 success.
combined_target_planar_evidence.basis: Unchanged TRAIN witness/birth edges and winding; recorded combined minimum clearance remains beyond the protected threshold. Independent all-row SOURCE and TARGET sparse reductions separately retain rank one.

historical_budget_scope.classification: Larger-budget private prototype diagnostic ONLY; not public bounded-API validation.
historical_budget_scope.explanation: 1440 rows and 2,550,696 SOURCE triangles exceed public hard caps; recorded SOURCE work/storage also exceed default logical budgets. Raising soft work/storage limits cannot remove hard caps. No caps were changed and no public success is claimed.

additional_seed0_oos_ablation.conclusion: TRAIN H0 .049 and selected H1 rank one do not transfer as a joint certificate: combined constructive H0 fails at 1.5295441934345244 > .05 although the selected H1 family survives. Accuracy improves while neighborhood overlap declines; zero clips mean the guard changes no prediction and supplies no observed repair.

remaining_uncertainties: Success is numerically reproduced in the matched historical numerical runtime, but the newer Python/NumPy/SciPy/Numba environment changes the guide and the construction is unsupported. Both frozen attempts are retained.
External Ripser ran in both public replays; its internal time/storage are not bounded by local reduction budgets. Exact source checks, not approximate bar endpoints, decide validity.
The full-960 success is one selected singleton case. Earlier transfer is 0/6 and frontier transfer 1/6, not evidence of a generally reliable constructor.
No joint OOS guarantee: fresh public combined H0 fails at 1.5295441934345244 > .05. Target planar rank one does not repair H0 or establish all-H1 preservation.
The combined SOURCE sparse audit uses 1440 vertices and 2550696 triangles, beyond public hard caps. It was not rerun through or attributed to the public sparse API.
OOS evidence is a single additional matched exact-guide seed, not the official shared-ANN multi-seed benchmark; accuracy improves while source-neighborhood fidelity declines.

The recorded label barrier and hash-matched frozen workflow are not an independently instrumented label-access trace. Historical runtime scopes differ; logical budgets are not RSS or wall-time guarantees.

public_replay.policy: One exclusive registered attempt per declared runtime; same seed, input, selector, graph policy and .05 tolerance. No output overwritten, no alternate cycle/seed searched.
public_replay.registration_scope: Prospective replay freezes of an already-known case, not retrospective preregistration of the original experiment.

attempts.name: modern_runtime_compatibility_attempt

result.external_solver_budget: Ripser internal time/storage outside bounded core budgets
result.planar_scope: real Euclidean represented float64 coordinates; not rounded-pdist equivalence
result.scope: all supplied TRAIN rows; selected same-ID family only

attempts.interpretation: Same selected cycle and valid source contract, but different guide hash/overlap and unsupported construction. Retained as a reproduction limitation, not an equivalent successful replay or infeasibility proof.

attempts.name: historical_numerical_runtime_replay

result.external_solver_budget: Ripser internal time/storage outside bounded core budgets
result.planar_scope: real Euclidean represented float64 coordinates; not rounded-pdist equivalence
result.scope: all supplied TRAIN rows; selected same-ID family only

attempts.interpretation: Numerical libraries matched recorded historical runtime; Ripser was installed without upgrading those libraries. Graph guide regenerated through the exact public default, not loaded from cache. Same selected source cycle and certified full-960 target.

public_replay.runtime_comparison_caveat: The second environment was declared after the first failed, specifically to match the recorded numerical runtime, not to optimize a seed or interval. Both results are reported; no claim that arbitrary package versions reproduce the success.
public_replay.diagnostic_code_delta: Between registrations the reproducer added refusal-category/aggregate-work reporting and an early return for an invalid construction-source contract. Both observed source contracts are valid; graph, selector, construction parameters and mathematics were unchanged. As-run code hashes and the first source snapshot are retained.

numerical_equivalence.scope: Offline public constructor audit directly compared all returned coordinates to the original as-run target. No coordinates are published. Equality of guides/normalized features is checked by shape/dtype/byte digests.

aggregation_closeout.method: Historical report extraction plus public API registered replays, independent fixed-output equivalence/H0/planar audit, and fixed-seed post-barrier figure; explicit scalar/hash allowlists.
aggregation_closeout.verification_scope: Fresh public results are separately labeled; historical larger-cap source diagnostics and earlier transfer arms remain attributed to their own reports.
verified_reusable_methods: Separate original as-run scalars from later private-port checks and future public replay.
Carry source rank, target rank and all-row H0 independently; selected target nonfilling alone is insufficient.
Use descriptive hash keys and scalar allowlists: raw H0 reports contain full trees and worst-pair identities; prediction reports contain per-query records and a protected-center location.
Read the combined audit SOURCE as well as TARGET fields: SOURCE triangle count and domain size disqualify it as a public hard-cap replay.
Pin numerical runtime as well as source bytes: a fixed seed and unchanged public graph algorithm did not reproduce the historical guide across numerical-library generations.
Report failed modern-runtime construction before reporting the matched-runtime success; one known successful case is not universal feasibility.
Compare regenerated guides and normalized features bytewise, and explicitly measure the residual coordinate difference; do not call a near-equal constructor result bitwise identical.
A separate public planar check can cover 1440 target rows without pretending a public 1024-row sparse source API validated that domain. Fresh all-row H0 still fails.
aggregation_closeout.privacy: No raw features, labels, row IDs, coordinates, cycle edges, tree edges, protected-center locations, raw logs, local paths or per-query records included.
aggregation_closeout.instruction_review: Repository/ancestor worker and AGENTS files checked again; none found. CONTRIBUTING and distribution checker reread. Verified experience and completion checkpoint are persisted in this aggregate and synthetic test docstring.
aggregation_closeout.numerical_test_caveat: Synthetic protocol tests use fixtures/mocks. Actual public full-960 replays and offline numerical audits are outside ordinary tests; no public sparse 1440-row run.

completed_aggregate_checks.scope: Inline report assertions only, not numerical recomputation or a built-distribution scan.

checkpoint.known_limitation: modern numerical stack remains unsupported; not repaired or retried

tests.scope: Only new synthetic protocol tests and existing native CTests; not a whole-repository or distribution build claim

fresh_public_combined_diagnostic.kind: offline fixed-output equivalence and OOS audit, not another policy/seed search

combined_target_planar.scope: selected target family in real represented float64 Euclidean geometry only

fresh_public_combined_diagnostic.combined_source_h1: NOT rerun with public sparse API: 1440 rows and 2550696 historical triangles exceed 1024/2000000 caps
fresh_public_combined_diagnostic.source_scope: Fresh public source rank claim is TRAIN960 only; combined source rank remains attributed to the historical larger-budget audit.

figure.scope: Original frozen one-seed OOS ablation, not modern-runtime replay, no hand-selected object. Labels post-barrier only; combined H0 failure explicit.

data_preprocessing.scope: Declared upstream cache preparation, not executed by the replay. The public reproducer takes one explicit prepared TRAIN member and performs no download or label/test-array decoding.
data_preprocessing.dataset: COIL-20 processed; Nene, Nayar and Murase, CUCS-005-96, February 1996
data_preprocessing.rights: No explicit dataset license was stated on the checked official pages; not MIT. Confirm terms with Columbia; no raw dataset is redistributed here.
data_preprocessing.resize: 128x128 uint8 grayscale to fixed 32x32 via Pillow LANCZOS, then flatten and float32 divide by 255
data_preprocessing.split: Every third 5-degree view held out: 20 objects, 48 TRAIN and 24 TEST views per object. Object/angle annotations define this split, not the layout training target.
data_preprocessing.pca: 64 components fit on TRAIN only; randomized solver, iterated_power=4, random_state=2026, whiten=False; same persisted transform applied to both splits, float32 cache.
data_preprocessing.upstream_cache_unit: Median positive distance of 20000 sampled TRAIN pairs, fixed preprocessing RNG2026; no TEST feature values used in the scale.
data_preprocessing.replay_unit: Additional exact full-TRAIN positive all-pair median on the supplied cache after conversion to float64; scale 1.0048316331206935. Selection uses raw D/scale, construction recomputes cdist(X/scale,X/scale).
data_preprocessing.pca_baseline: Fresh TRAIN-only full-SVD PCA2 of the normalized supplied 64-dimensional reference, not another raw-image preprocessing fit.
data_preprocessing.code_hash_caveat: Current preparation code matches the documented recipe; original as-run provenance is the recorded cache/metadata hashes, not an unrecorded historical source revision.
